title: AnnounceTrustStore::ephemeral() is a public silent downgrade
description: announce_store.rs exposes ephemeral() as pub API (also re-exported via lib.rs). The gateway keeps its equivalent private (gateway.rs:77). A production caller using it silently loses all durable pin/floor protection: after every restart all pins vanish and IID-collision attackers can re-pin at will. Fix: make it #[cfg(test)]/private, or require explicit opt-in (separate type or feature) so durable protection cannot be silently dropped. Found by security codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-12zy.
